name: wasmcheat
description: Browser-only Cheat Engine-style memory tool for WebAssembly, driven by an MCP agent.

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @wasmcheat/protocol && npm run build --workspace @wasmcheat/wasm-instrument && npm run build --workspace @wasmcheat/page-agent && npm run build --workspace @wasmcheat/extension && npm run build --workspace @wasmcheat/mcp-server && npm run build --workspace @wasmcheat/demo-app
scripts.test: npm run build && vitest run && playwright test
